messages:
sophia: quick idea  we need a tight one-pager that bundles security, SLA bullets, and a short deploy-mode decision guide. goal: webinar follow-up + inbound lead magnet.
leo: agree. keep it 1 page, two-column. left: value + quick callouts. right: deploy tradeoffs + CTA.
marie: security copy should be short bullets: KMS/HSM support, customer-managed keys, SOC2, audit logs, data residency controls. avoid definitive "compliant" claims until legal signs off.
derek: for SLA section: state SLOs (99.9% uptime typical), guaranteed latency tiers for Dedicated, and fallback behavior (auto-failover to hosted). include a one-line "what happens if" flow.
sophia: benchmark callout idea: "95th pct latency: 80ms on Dedicated (8k ctx) with KV warm path; estimated $0.45 / 1k tokens for typical assistive-chat workload" (need infra numbers).
leo: let's use a conservative delta vs competitor: "~30% lower per-token cost at 95th pct for customer workloads" until we have formal bench. mark as provisional.
marie: webinar CTA: "Watch 30min: Deploy Modes for Regulated Orgs" + link to recording. marketing ops: attach the one-pager to post-webinar email and add SFDC tag `mp_enterprise_one_pager`.
derek: sales routing pseudocode (ops can implement):
```
if lead.source == "webinar" and lead.tag == "mp_enterprise_one_pager":
  route -> enterprise_inbound_queue
  set lead.priority = "level_1"
  if lead.compliance == true:
    notify -> solutions_engineer
```
sophia: add `requested_feature` and `security_priority` fields to the form so PMs and security see patterns.
leo: include a 1-line ROI for finance: "Predictable unit costs and 20-40% lower infra maintenance overhead vs self-hosting." (engineers will refine).
marie: i'll draft the security checklist and brief legal note for claims. derek: can you chase infra for safe bench numbers by Tue?
derek: yes, i'll ping infra for a microbench and a conservative figure.
salesbot: created doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1zExample-enterprise-onepager (permissions: marketing,sales) :white_check_mark:
sophia: timeline: final PDF for webinar followup by next Wed. ops to map SFDC tags by Fri.
leo: i'll assemble design + copy after derek posts numbers. thanks all :) :rocket:
